data.source_title: Surveillance of Patients in the Waiting Area of the Department of Emergency Medicine
data.locator: Abstract; Methods and Results, waiting-area wireless vital sign monitoring.
data.source_setting: Single high-volume German emergency department; selected patients with acute cardiac/pulmonary symptoms or potentially life-threatening conditions.
data.source_period: Study period not specified in the inspected abstract/text excerpt.
data.source_n: 230 enrolled patients; 4 terminated participation early; 684 monitoring hours.
data.quantity: Duration of waiting-area vital-sign observation in feasibility cohort
data.unit: minutes per patient (median, IQR); total monitored hours
data.source_evidence_basis: Single-center observational cross-sectional feasibility study reports enrollment, monitoring time, aggregate monitored hours, and use of continuous wireless vital-sign data to assist care.
data.limitations: Selected higher-risk consenting patients, small feasibility cohort, no control group and no estimate of deterioration incidence or outcome benefit; source period unavailable from excerpt.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Treat waiting-room monitoring and detection/escalation as a possible staffed capability for a high-risk subgroup, not a default universal workflow or a probability model.
